home.heroSubtext: Thoughtfully designed clothing, tailored to feel uniquely yours.
home.collection1Description: Handloom Chanderi, silk-organza, and tissue ensembles available unstitched or custom-stitched to your proportions.
home.collection2Description: Architectural raw silk and linen-silk tunics paired with fluid tailored trousers for understated poise.
home.collection3Description: Artisanal mulmul blouses and hand-embroidered silk kurtas finished with heirloom pin-tucks and shell closures.
home.madeText: Love a design but want the perfect fit? Let us create it just for you. From shoulder slope and sleeve drape to neckline contour, Reshma's atelier cuts a dedicated pattern to your individual measurements.
home.storyQuote: True luxury is not mass-produced. It is found in the quiet confidence of a garment cut exclusively for the woman who wears it.
home.storyText: Founded with a devotion to slow fashion and heirloom needlework, Reshma's Needle bridges the grace of fine handloom textiles with the intimacy of a personal tailoring studio. Whether you choose an unstitched three-piece fabric or commission a bespoke silhouette, every thread is inspected by hand.

contact.title: Contact The Atelier
contact.intro: Have a question about fabric drape, custom sizing, or bridal and festive orders? Reach out directly via WhatsApp or send an inquiry below.
